newsitem.title: USA: Iowa corn, soybean harvest nearly complete.
newsitem.headline: Iowa corn, soybean harvest nearly complete.

text.p: Iowa's corn and soybean harvest was nearly complete in the week ended Sunday but cold temperatures slowed dry down, Iowa's Agricultural Statistics Service said.

Soybeans were 98 percent harvested as of Sunday. Harvest would normally be complete by this time of year. Corn was 80 percent harvested, slightly below the five-year average of 83 percent, the report said.
Crop reporters in the central, east-central and southwest portions of the state reported that corn was "drying slowly in the fields.
"This is slowing final harvest and keeping drying facilities busy," the report said.

Off-farm grain storage availability was rated 12 percent short, 82 percent adequate and six percent surplus. On-farm storage was rated seven percent short, 86 percent adequate and seven percent surplus.
Soil moisture was rated five percent short, 82 percent adequate and 13 percent surplus.
